newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Zaire talks delayed one hour by technical problem.
newsitem.headline: Zaire talks delayed one hour by technical problem.

text.p: The start of talks on Saturday between the two sides in Zaire's civil war were delayed by an hour due to the late arrival of Zairean Foreign Minister Kamanda wa Kamanda, a South African government official said.
A spokesman for South African Deputy-President Thabo Mbeki, who will officially open the talks, said the meeting scheduled for 0800 GMT would start at about 0900 GMT.
He added the delay of the first face-to-face meeting between the warring parties was purely technical and had no political reasons.
